title: APIM Policies: Entra ID JWT validation & rate limiting

test_cases.name: No token rejection
test_cases.input_setup: Submit request without Authorization header against validate-jwt policy
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized returned with WWW-Authenticate challenge
test_cases.evidence: validate-jwt policy present; missing Authorization header rejected with 401 + WWW-Authenticate

test_cases.name: Valid Entra ID token accepted
test_cases.input_setup: Submit request with valid signed Entra ID JWT token
test_cases.expected_result: JWT claims validated and request proxied to backend with HTTP 200
test_cases.evidence: Valid Entra ID Bearer token validated successfully; request forwarded to backend

test_cases.name: Expired token rejection
test_cases.input_setup: Submit request with expired JWT timestamp
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 401 returned with explicit 'Token expired' message
test_cases.evidence: Expired JWT rejected with HTTP 401 and explicit expiration error

test_cases.name: Rate limit enforcement (50 req/s cap)
test_cases.input_setup: Fire 100 requests in rapid succession against rate-limit policy set to 50
test_cases.expected_result: First 50 requests return 200; next 50 return 429 Too Many Requests
test_cases.evidence: Rate limiting enforced: exactly first 50 allowed (200), subsequent 50 throttled (429)

test_cases.name: Per-client rate limit isolation
test_cases.input_setup: Saturate client A rate limit quota and submit concurrent request from client B
test_cases.expected_result: Client B request succeeds independently without interference from Client A quota
test_cases.evidence: Per-client rate isolation verified: Client A throttled (429), while Client B succeeds (200)
